(14 July) |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |prevseason= [[2021 Primera Nacional|2021]] |nextseason= [[2023 Primera Nacional|2023]] }} The '''2022 Argentine Primera Nacional''', also known as the '''Campeonato de Primera Nacional Torneo Malvinas Argentinas 2022''',{{cite web|url=https://www.afa.com.ar/es/posts/se-realizo-el-sorteo-de-la-primera-nacional |title=Se realizó el sorteo del Torneo Malvinas Argentinas 2022 de la Primera Nacional |publisher=AFA |language=es |date=13 January 2022 |access-date=13 January 2022}} was the 38th season of the [[Primera Nacional]], the second-tier competition of [[Football in Argentina|Argentine]] football. The season began on 11 February and ended on 19 November 2022. Thirty-seven teams competed in the league, thirty-three returning from the [[2021 Primera Nacional|2021 season]], two teams promoted from [[Torneo Federal A]] and two from [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. [[Club Atlético Belgrano|Belgrano]] were the champions, clinching direct promotion as well as their first title in the competition with two matches in hand and a 3–2 victory over [[Club Atlético Brown|Brown (A)]] on 25 September 2022.{{cite web |url=https://www.tycsports.com/primera-nacional/brown-adrogue-vs-belgrano-en-vivo-hora-donde-ver-y-formaciones-id466537.html |title=Belgrano se consagró campeón de la Primera Nacional y retornó a Primera |trans-title=Belgrano became champions of the Primera Nacional and returned to ''Primera'' |publisher=TyC Sports |language=es |date=25 September 2022 |access-date=25 September 2022}} [[Instituto Atlético Central Córdoba|Instituto]] were the other promoted team, winning the Torneo Reducido after defeating [[Estudiantes de Buenos Aires|Estudiantes (BA)]] in the final.{{cite web |url=https://www.infobae.com/deportes/2022/11/19/instituto-y-estudiantes-de-buenos-aires-definen-el-ultimo-ascenso-a-la-liga-profesional-hora-tv-y-formaciones/ |title=Instituto empató con Estudiantes de Caseros y ascendió a la Liga Profesional |trans-title=Instituto drew with Estudiantes de Caseros and were promoted to the Liga Profesional |publisher=Infobae |language=es |date=19 November 2022 |access-date=21 November 2022}} ==Format== Thirty-seven teams played each other once for a total of thirty-six rounds. The top-placed team was the champion and also earned promotion to the [[Argentine Primera División|Primera División]]. The teams placed from second to thirteenth place competed in the "Torneo Reducido" for the second promotion berth after the regular season ended, with the team placed second entering in the third round, the team placed third entering in the second round and the remaining teams entering in the first round. The bottom two teams were relegated at the end of the season, as relegation was reinstated after being suspended for two years due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/es-ar/noticias/primera-nacional-2022-formato-calendario-fixture-ascensos/bltc4d32b22c344955e |title=Primera Nacional 2022: formato, calendario, fixture y cuántos ascensos y descensos tendrá |publisher=Goal.com |language=es |date=12 January 2022 |access-date=20 January 2022}} The draw to decide the fixture of the season was held on 13 January 2022 at the [[Argentine Football Association]]'s [[Ezeiza, Buenos Aires|Ezeiza]] offices. ==Club information== === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2022 Primera Nacional teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
